sloka: आज्ञप्ता रावणेनैता राक्षस्यो मामतर्जयन् ।हते तस्मिन्न कुर्युर्हि तर्जनं वानरोत्तम ।। ६.११६.४२ ।।
transliteration: ājñaptā rāvaṇenaitā rākṣasyo māmatarjayan ।hate tasminna kuryurhi tarjanaṁ vānarottama ।। 6.116.42 ।।

translations.english: Through the adverse working of my fate and my own former misdeeds all this has befallen me; one must indeed experience the fruit of one's own deeds.
